+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Dict, Mapping
+
+import openai
+
+
+DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS: Dict[str, float] = {
+    "self_harm": 0.75,
+    "violence": 0.80,
+    "hate": 0.70,
+    "sexual": 0.85,
+}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SafetyDecision:
+    allow: bool
+    scores: Mapping[str, float]
+    threshold_exceeded: str | None
+
+
+def _score_text_with_openai(text: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    client = openai.OpenAI(api_key=api_key)
+    response = client.moderations.create(
+        model="omni-moderation-latest",
+        input=text,
+    )
+    result = response.results[0]
+    categories = result.categories
+    scores = result.category_scores
+    return {
+        "self_harm": float(scores.self_harm),
+        "violence": float(scores.violence),
+        "hate": float(scores.hate),
+        "sexual": float(scores.sexual),
+        "self_harm_category": float(categories.self_harm),
+        "violence_category": float(categories.violence),
+        "hate_category": float(categories.hate),
+        "sexual_category": float(categories.sexual),
+    }
+
+
+def allow_text(text: str, thresholds: Mapping[str, float] | None = None) -> SafetyDecision:
+    active_thresholds = dict(DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS if thresholds is None else thresholds)
+    scores = _score_text_with_openai(text)
+    for category, threshold in active_thresholds.items():
+        if scores.get(category, 0.0) >= threshold:
+            return SafetyDecision(False, scores, category)
+    return SafetyDecision(True, scores, None)

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: redact_unsafe.py
+import json
+import os
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Iterable, List, Sequence, Tuple
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini")
+OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class UnsafeSpan:
+    start: int
+    end: int
+    label: str = "unsafe"
+
+
+def _merge_spans(spans: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]]) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
+    ordered = sorted((s, e) for s, e in spans if s < e)
+    if not ordered:
+        return []
+    merged = [ordered[0]]
+    for start, end in ordered[1:]:
+        last_start, last_end = merged[-1]
+        if start <= last_end:
+            merged[-1] = (last_start, max(last_end, end))
+        else:
+            merged.append((start, end))
+    return merged
+
+
+def _mask_text(text: str, spans: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]], replacement: str = "[REDACTED]") -> str:
+    merged = _merge_spans(spans)
+    if not merged:
+        return text
+    parts: List[str] = []
+    cursor = 0
+    for start, end in merged:
+        start = max(0, min(start, len(text)))
+        end = max(0, min(end, len(text)))
+        if start > cursor:
+            parts.append(text[cursor:start])
+        parts.append(replacement)
+        cursor = max(cursor, end)
+    if cursor < len(text):
+        parts.append(text[cursor:])
+    return "".join(parts)
+
+
+def _heuristic_unsafe_spans(text: str) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
+    patterns = [
+        r"\b(?:sk-|rk-|pk-|ak-)[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}\b",
+        r"\b(?:eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_=-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_=-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_=-]{10,})\b",
+        r"\b(?:\d[ -]*?){13,19}\b",
+        r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b",
+        r"\b(?:\+?\d{1,3}[\s.-]?)?(?:\(?\d{3}\)?[\s.-]?)\d{3}[\s.-]?\d{4}\b",
+        r"\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b",
+    ]
+    spans: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
+    for pattern in patterns:
+        for match in re.finditer(pattern, text):
+            spans.append(match.span())
+    return _merge_spans(spans)
+
+
+def _openai_redact_spans(text: str) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
+    if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
+        return _heuristic_unsafe_spans(text)
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": (
+                    "Identify unsafe spans in the provided text. Return strict JSON with key spans, "
+                    "where each span is an object containing start, end, and label. "
+                    "Only include spans that should be redacted."
+                ),
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": text},
+        ],
+        "response_format": {
+            "type": "json_schema",
+            "json_schema": {
+                "name": "unsafe_spans",
+                "schema": {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "spans": {
+                            "type": "array",
+                            "items": {
+                                "type": "object",
+                                "properties": {
+                                    "start": {"type": "integer"},
+                                    "end": {"type": "integer"},
+                                    "label": {"type": "string"},
+                                },
+                                "required": ["start", "end", "label"],
+                                "additionalProperties": False,
+                            },
+                        }
+                    },
+                    "required": ["spans"],
+                    "additionalProperties": False,
+                },
+            },
+        },
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    text_out = ""
+    if isinstance(data, dict):
+        output = data.get("output", [])
+        for item in output:
+            content = item.get("content", []) if isinstance(item, dict) else []
+            for block in content:
+                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                    text_out += block.get("text", "")
+    if not text_out:
+        return _heuristic_unsafe_spans(text)
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(text_out)
+        spans = [(int(x["start"]), int(x["end"])) for x in parsed.get("spans", [])]
+        return _merge_spans(spans)
+    except Exception:
+        return _heuristic_unsafe_spans(text)
+
+
+def redact_unsafe(text: str, replacement: str = "[REDACTED]") -> str:
+    spans = _openai_redact_spans(text)
+    return _mask_text(text, spans, replacement=replacement)
+
+
+def flag_unsafe(text: str) -> List[UnsafeSpan]:
+    spans = _openai_redact_spans(text)
+    return [UnsafeSpan(start=s, end=e) for s, e in spans]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    data = sys.stdin.read()
+    sys.stdout.write(redact_unsafe(data))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

import json
import os
from typing import Any, Dict

import requests


OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"


def moderate_text(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    api_key = os.getenv(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV)
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing OPENAI_API_KEY")
    response = requests.post(
        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        data=json.dumps({"model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, "input": text}),
        timeout=30,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    payload = response.json()
    result = payload["results"][0]
    categories = result.get("categories", {})
    category_scores = result.get("category_scores", {})
    flagged = bool(result.get("flagged", False))
    score = max(category_scores.values(), default=0.0)
    return {
        "flagged": flagged,
        "score": score,
        "categories": categories,
        "category_scores": category_scores,
        "raw": payload,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    text = sys.stdin.read()
    print(json.dumps(moderate_text(text), ensure_ascii=False))
